visual_action: A slideshow of still, unflattering photographs of Donald Trump. The sequence includes a close-up of his face with his mouth agape, an extreme zoom-in on a small white object on his lower teeth, a shot of his hands clasped showing a large dark bruise on one, a full-body shot of him in a suit, and a close-up of his other hand which appears discolored.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the sole subject of all the images in the video, and the caption asks, 'what’s going on with him?'

spoken_summary: The audio is a rap song with lyrics including, "Percocets...lookin' for a f*ck I could give. All these hatin' b*tches plottin' why they can't let me live."
audio_music: A modern rap/trap track ('Skies' by Tooche) plays throughout the video, creating an edgy and defiant mood.
editing_pacing: A slideshow of still images with quick cuts between each photo, timed to the music.
central_claim: Donald Trump is physically and mentally unwell, as suggested by a series of photos showing bruises, odd expressions, and a foreign object in his mouth.
intended_effect: To make the viewer question Donald Trump's health and fitness for office.
uncertainty_flags: Uncertain about the nature of the white object visible on Donald Trump's teeth in the close-up shot.
